claims.text: Medical mgnt (until 10–12 wk): misoprostol 800 mcg vaginally, repeated if needed;
claims.quote: Until 10 to 12 weeks gestation, medical management may be used if spontaneous expulsion does not occur or if a patient prefers use of medications to allow a more predictable process. A common medication regimen is 800 mcg of misoprostol vaginally; a repeat dose may be necessary.

claims.text: mifepristone 200 mg PO 24 h b4 misoprostol improves success
claims.quote: Administering 200 mg of mifepristone orally 24 hours before the misoprostol can significantly improve treatment success, if mifepristone is available (1).

claims.text: Septic abortion: start IV broad-spectrum abx STAT,
claims.quote: Treatment of septic abortion includes intravenous broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy, which should be initiated immediately.

claims.text: then evacuate the uterus once stable
claims.quote: In addition, uterine evacuation should be performed once the patient is stable.
